days.label: Mon, 18 May 2026

trades.notes: Pharma defensive profile as safe haven against crude spike and weak Rupee. Stock showed extreme relative strength — absorbing selling pressure while Nifty bled. Institutional backing confirmed.
trades.execution: Perfect execution. Entry timed well, target hit exactly as planned.

trades.strategy: Bear Call Spread — tactical intraday index short
trades.notes: Tactical short on sell-on-rise momentum near 23,500. V-shape recovery invalidated thesis. Cut at stop loss — correct decision.
trades.execution: Short strike placed too close to money during volatile recovery. On high-VIX gap-down days, wait until 10:30 before initiating index positions.

trades.strategy: Bear Call Spread — positional option selling (5 lots CLOSED today)
trades.note: 5 lots (150 contracts) closed at 09:37. Balance lots remain open — see Trade 4.
trades.notes: Partial profit booking — closed 5 of 10 lots profitably. Short 53500 CE bought back at 647.47 vs entry 1606.13 (+958.66/contract). Long 54500 CE sold at 291.35 vs entry 1012.92 (-721.57/contract).
trades.execution: Excellent timing. Closed near market open capturing maximum overnight theta decay. Retained balance lots to harvest further decay into expiry.

trades.strategy: Bear Call Spread — positional option selling (10 lots OPEN — averaged)
trades.note: Original 5 lots (150 contracts) carried from May 18 + 5 new lots (150 contracts) added on May 20. Total: 10 lots (300 contracts). New lot prices back-calculated from broker avg. Short 53500 CE new lots: 744.66. Long 54500 CE new lots: 309.49.

addition.rationale: Averaging down as premiums decayed. Short leg LTP ~649, long leg LTP ~252 at time of addition.

legs.label: Short leg — 53500 CE OPEN (10 lots, avg)
Hedge leg — 54500 CE OPEN (10 lots, avg)

trades.notes: Position averaged up to 10 lots on May 20. Net unrealized: +35,208. Short 53500 CE down 44.75% from avg entry (649.40 vs 1175.33). Long 54500 CE down 61.79% from avg entry (252.70 vs 661.26). Both legs decaying well — BankNifty expiry approaching.
trades.execution: New lots added at deeply decayed premiums (Short at 744.66, Long at 309.49). Averaging improves blended entry significantly. Monitor for exit near expiry.

trades.strategy: Bear Call Spread — positional option selling (26 lots OPEN)
trades.note: Active Bear Call Spread. Short 23200 CE / Long 23400 CE. 650 contracts per leg (26 lots x 25). LTP updated to May 20 morning snapshot.
trades.notes: Bear Call Spread under pressure. Short 23200 CE up 21.01% against entry (LTP 603.95 vs avg 499.08). Long 23400 CE hedge up 18.57% (LTP 457.80 vs avg 386.09) — partially offsetting. Net loss: -21,554. If Nifty sustains above 23,200, consider rolling short up or adding hedge.
trades.execution: Monitoring closely. Need Nifty to pull back below 23,200 for premium compression on short leg.

lessons.detail: Cut losses immediately when thesis is invalidated. The 23700 CE hedge offset Rs 8,554 of the Rs 18,378 short loss. Hedge structure saved the day.

lessons.rule: No index trades in the first hour on gap-down / high-VIX days
lessons.detail: Intraday spread forced too early in morning panic. Wait for 10:30 stabilisation on gap-down or VIX > 18 days.
lessons.nias_note: NIAS v3 blocks trading until 10:30 on gap-down days

lessons.rule: Partial profit booking on positional option selling is smart
lessons.detail: Closing 5 of 10 BankNifty lots when short leg was down 44% locked in Rs 35,563 profit while keeping remaining lots for further theta decay.
Intraday 23,500 CE short was too close to the money. Short strike must be at least 1.5x ATR OTM from current price.
lessons.nias_note: NIAS v3 suggests OTM strike levels based on live ATR in every signal

lessons.rule: Trail stops to VWAP not a tight percentage buffer
lessons.detail: 0.5% trailing invites stop-loss hunting in high-volatility sessions. Trail to VWAP or cost price.
lessons.nias_note: NIAS v3 displays live VWAP level as trailing stop in every signal alert
